description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
uses.cardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
